description: Massively multilingual zero-shot TTS model from k2-fsa for 600+ languages, supporting short-reference voice cloning, attribute-based voice design, pronunciation controls, and nonverbal tags.

request.name: language
request.description: Synthesis language code or label; omitted uses automatic language selection.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript for speaker reference audio used in voice cloning.

request.name: instruct
request.description: Voice-design instruction such as speaker attributes, accent, style, or delivery.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed for reproducible output; omitted value keeps the session RNG state.

request.name: speed
request.description: Speech speed multiplier used for target-length estimation; default 1.0.

request.name: duration_sec
request.description: Target output duration in seconds; omitted uses the model's estimated duration.

request.name: denoise
request.description: Add the denoise control token when reference audio is present; default true.

request.name: preprocess_prompt
request.description: Preprocess speaker reference audio before tokenization; default true.

request.name: postprocess_output
request.description: Apply output postprocessing and trimming; default true.

request.name: layer_penalty_factor
request.description: Layer-order penalty used while selecting masked audio-codebook positions; default 5.0.

request.name: position_temperature
request.description: Gumbel temperature for masked-position selection; default 5.0.

request.name: class_temperature
request.description: Audio-token class sampling temperature; default 0 for greedy class selection.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Target chunk duration for automatic long-form splitting; default 15 seconds.

request.name: audio_chunk_threshold_sec
request.description: Estimated duration above which long-form generation is split into chunks; default 30 seconds.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Explicit long-form text chunk size in Unicode codepoints. Omitted value uses duration-based automatic chunking.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared generator weight storage type; default native.

session.name: generator_weight_type
session.description: Generator weight storage type; defaults to weight_type, which defaults to native.

session.name: audio_tokenizer_weight_type
session.description: Audio tokenizer weight storage type; default native.

session.name: audio_tokenizer_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Audio tokenizer graph arena size in MiB; default 128.

session.name: generator_prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Generator prefill graph arena size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: generator_decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Generator decode graph arena size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: audio_tokenizer_weight_context_mb
session.description: Audio tokenizer weight context size in MiB; default 128.

session.name: generator_weight_context_mb
session.description: Generator weight context size in MiB; default 256.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged runtime graphs after request phases; default false. Cannot be combined with perf_mode=flash_attention.

session.name: perf_mode
session.description: Generator performance mode; default off keeps the exact-safe attention path. flash_attention requires mem_saver=false.

packages.description: Egyptian Arabic and Arabic-English code-switching fine-tune of OmniVoice from mohammedaly22/VoiceTut-TTS (same architecture and audio tokenizer as OmniVoice). Use language=arz.
